[LHYD.4.3.1] Samples have no schema in the same sense — they are
`(entity_id, field, ts, value)` tuples. Hydrated samples arrive as a
dedicated `HydratedSample` schema, `ttl`-scoped at 24_h, whose slots are:

| Slot | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `adapter` | String | which adapter supplied the sample |
| `entity_id` | String | the entity the sample belongs to |
| `field` | String | the sampled field |
| `ts` | Time | sample timestamp, source time ([LFAC.9.2]) |
| `value` | Float | the value, or stringified per `value_type` |
| `value_type` | String | `"Float"`, `"Int"`, `"String"` or `"Bool"` |
| `corr` | String | correlation id of the hydration that produced it |
